changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Keep user-arranged time independent of occurrence identity and automatic retry time. Preserve all todos and reminder states.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE user_reminder SET scheduled_at=CASE WHEN plan_id IS NOT NULL AND requested_at>0 AND requested_at<>original_due_at THEN requested_at WHEN status='scheduled' AND delivery_count=0 THEN due_at WHEN original_due_at>0 THEN original_due_at WHEN requested_at>0 THEN requested_at ELSE due_at END;
